description: A candlelit room with rough plank walls and shutters. Five or six men in dark 18th-century coats and waistcoats crowd around a wooden table covered in maps, folded letters, a quill, an inkwell and a pocket watch. A bearded older man in the centre leans over the map, and a younger man in a maroon coat gestures. Another man on the left seated at the table writes. The scribbled papers show no legible text. Painted oil style, filling the whole frame.
